concept.title: RootishArrayStack 的按位插入与删除
concept.core_question: RootishArrayStack 如何跨数组块完成按位插入和删除？
concept.summary: 它通过 get/set 按逻辑下标逐位搬移元素，插入右移后写入，删除左移后收回空块。
concept.definition: RootishArrayStack 的 add(i,x) 在总容量不足时先 grow，令 n 增加，再从尾部向 i 逐个执行 set(j,get(j-1))，最后 set(i,x)。remove(i) 保存原值，从 i 起执行 set(j,get(j+1)) 左移，令 n 减少，并在存在多余空块时 shrink。忽略块增删时，两者分别为 $O(1+n-i)$ 与 $O(n-i)$。

relations.description: 理解《RootishArrayStack 的按位插入与删除》是继续学习目标知识点的直接基础。

rookie_explanation.analogy: 书虽分布在不同层书架，但仍按一个总编号序列搬移；插入时从后向前挪，删除时从前向后补。
rookie_explanation.boundary: 类比不表示相邻逻辑元素一定处在同一数组块，也不含 grow/shrink 的分配成本。

related_concepts.title: RootishArrayStack 的下标到块映射
related_concepts.core_question: RootishArrayStack 如何由逻辑下标 i 计算块号和块内下标？
related_concepts.summary: 块号为 ceil((-3+sqrt(9+8i))/2)，块内下标为 i-b(b+1)/2。
related_concepts.definition: 对逻辑下标 i，所在块 b 是满足 $(b+1)(b+2)/2\ge i+1$ 的最小非负整数，因此 $b=\lceil(-3+\sqrt{9+8i})/2\rceil$。在 b 之前共有 $b(b+1)/2$ 个槽位，所以块内下标为 $j=i-b(b+1)/2$。据此 get 与 set 可直接访问 blocks[b][j]。

related_concepts.title: RootishArrayStack 的时间与空间复杂度
related_concepts.core_question: RootishArrayStack 在随机访问、更新和额外空间之间做了怎样的权衡？
related_concepts.summary: 它保留 O(1) 随机访问和 O(1+n-i) 按位更新，同时把浪费空间降为 O(sqrt(n))。
related_concepts.definition: RootishArrayStack 的 get 与 set 为 $O(1)$，忽略 grow 与 shrink 时，add(i,x) 与 remove(i) 为 $O(1+n-i)$。从空结构开始的 m 次更新中，块增长和收缩的总成本为 $O(m)$；在任意时刻，未使用槽位和块目录造成的额外空间为 $O(\sqrt n)$。

source_records.content: If we use any of the data structures in this chapter for representing the \ensuremath{\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathit{blocks}}}} list, then \ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathrm{get}(\ensuremath{\mathit{i}})}} and \ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathrm{set}(\ensuremath{\mathit{i}},\ensuremath{\mathit{x}})}} will each run in constant time. The \ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathrm{add}(\ensuremath{\mathit{i}},\ensuremath{\mathit{x}})}} method will, by now, look familiar. We first check to see if our data structure is full, by checking if the number of blocks, \ensuremath{\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathit{r}}}}, is such that $\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathit{r}}}}(\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathit{r}}}}+1)/2 = \ensuremath{\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathit{n}}}}$. If so, we call \ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathrm{grow}()}} to add another block. With this done, we shift elements with indices $\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathit{i}}}},\ldots,\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathit{n}}}}-1$ to the right by one position to make room for the new element with index \ensuremath{\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathit{i}}}}:

Ignoring the cost of the \ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathrm{grow}()}} operation, the cost of an \ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathrm{add}(\ensuremath{\mathit{i}},\ensuremath{\mathit{x}})}} operation is dominated by the cost of shifting and is therefore $O(1+\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathit{n}}}}-\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathit{i}}}})$, just like an ArrayStack. The \ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathrm{remove}(\ensuremath{\mathit{i}})}} operation is similar to \ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathrm{add}(\ensuremath{\mathit{i}},\ensuremath{\mathit{x}})}}. It shifts the elements with indices $\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathit{i}}}}+1,\ldots,\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathit{n}}}}$ left by one position and then, if there is more than one empty block, it calls the \ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathrm{shrink}()}} method to remove all but one of the unused blocks:

Once again, ignoring the cost of the \ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathrm{shrink}()}} operation, the cost of a \ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathrm{remove}(\ensuremath{\mathit{i}})}} operation is dominated by the cost of shifting and is therefore $O(\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathit{n}}}}-\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathit{i}}}})$.
